experiment: T1 temporal misalignment (stale image + current alignment), k=1..8 complete, k9/10 in progress
platform: AutoDL instance, RTX 4090 D, PyTorch 2.1.0 / CUDA 12.1 / Python 3.10 (conda env bevfusion)
dataset: nuScenes v1.0-trainval, val split, 6019 keyframe samples

definition.substitution: 6 camera images replaced by real historical frames k steps back along sample_data.prev; calibration, poses, LiDAR and GT of the current sample kept unchanged
definition.key_fact: one prev-chain step is only ~50-100ms (chain walks all camera frames at 12-20Hz), so integer k gives ~100ms granularity

conclusions: mAP degrades monotonically 0.6869 -> 0.6470 (k1..k8) with shrinking per-step decay; fusion converges to LiDAR-only behaviour.
BACKFIRE CONFIRMED: at k=8 (mean 677ms) fusion mAP 0.6470 < LiDAR-only 0.6496 (-0.26pt), NDS -0.34pt. k=7 is within noise of the crossover.
mATE peaks at k=3 then regresses toward LiDAR-only; mAOE keeps rising past crossover (0.3067 vs 0.2913) — stale images actively mislead orientation estimation.
k=9/10 running (eligible 5719/5718) to quantify negative-gain depth past the crossover.
